item.title: Investigating the proactive avoidance of pre-emption conflicts with emergency vehicle signal pre-emption and route selection integration
item.description: The study aims to improve average emergency vehicle (EV) response times by proactivelyavoiding pre-emption conflicts by integrating emergency vehicle signal pre-emption (EVSP)and route selection. Pre-emption in this work means to anticipate an emergency vehicleapproaching a signalled intersection, and attempting to ensure it is provided with right ofway. item.title: A guiding rubric and usage manual for the doctoral supervisor and doctoral student in the discipline of statistics
item.description: Following the discussions documented by [3], guidelines were devised to support active earlycareer,emerging doctoral supervisors in Statistics in South Africa. These guidelines developedare incorporated into a guiding rubric and this associated usage manual. The rubricis not presented as a formal set of rules, but rather a dynamic document encouraging thegrowth of both the novice supervisor and the doctoral student.
